selection.rule: per target, the paper-table row with the best mean 5-fold CV smape; its best_valid__smape.pth checkpoint (the fold and epoch with the best validation score of that criterion over all folds and epochs, trained on the other folds)
selection.cv_protocol: stratified k-fold CV over all architectures, no held-out test set

total_energy.units: J per frame (runtime power x latency)

dynamic_energy.units: J per frame ((runtime - idle power) x latency)
